_maxPrsPerCycle: Was 1 a cycle and 8 a day. David's call on 2026-10-31 ("tackle bigger PRs at night and really push the PC"): up to 3 PRs a cycle and 12 a day. They still merge only when every check is green (autonomy).
_comment: Allowlist of repos the factory may open PRs on (and merge them, see autonomy): RepoHQ, the live idea products with CI, and the owner's live focus projects (family-tree earns, AI-Trend-Tracker; both public, so the free pool may work on them). Since 2026-10-12 it no longer maintains dormant personal repos (Open-Travel and five others): in the 14 days before, 201 attempts produced 22 merges, mostly lint and docs, and a quarter hit the free models' rate limits. family-tree and AI-Trend-Tracker came back on 2026-10-13: dropping them left 80 critical/high alerts on live sites with nobody patching. A private repo gets only the local model and deterministic fixes (npm audit fix) at $0. Add a live idea product once it has a CI workflow (codespend has none yet). Repos opened from RepoHQ's repo page (repositories.factory_enabled) come on top of this list.

autonomy._why: The owner's call (2026-10-12): the factory merges its own PRs once every check is green and nothing objected (smoke test, adversarial reviewer, a hold label, a review asking for changes), and reverts a merge whose commit turns the base branch red. He reviews it in the morning email. PRs touching protectedPaths (the factory's own code, CI workflows, the model router) stay with him. factory/lib/automerge.ts.
